+Use this to read the canaries you registered and whether any was touched.
+Use this to see who pays a receiving address, and how much; for measured facts about an address before paying it, use payee_facts.
+Use this before relying on any figure.
+Use this for anomalies across the market, or one kind of them; to ask whether one agent's newest payment is in character, use agent_pattern.
+Use this to price a dated evidence pack, the one paid item here, before buying it over x402.

+Use this to see who paid one agent, and whether its reviews come from wallets that paid it; to check one paying wallet, use payer_check.
+Use this for the agents that rank highest and why; to look up a known agent by id, name or wallet, use find_agent.
+Use this for everything the ledger holds about one agent in one answer; for up to 60 agents at once, use fleet_check.
+Use this to check that our published total and statement log verify, from a leaf to a signed root.
